description.zh:
是否删除媒体流的物理文件。
若媒资的存储地址是用户自有oss，需对服务角色AliyunICEDefaultRole提前进行授权<props="china">，具体操作请参见[OSS授权管理](~~607144#0737d9c037zyp~~)</props>。

><notice>仅支持删除转码流的物理文件，删除源文件的物理文件暂不支持。></notice>
description.en:
Specifies whether to delete the physical file of the media stream.

If the media asset is stored in your own Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket, you must authorize the service role AliyunICEDefaultRole in advance. <props="china">For more information, see [Authorize IMS to delete recording files in OSS](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449331.html#p-ko2-wc7-iad).</props>

You can delete only the physical files of transcoded streams, but not the physical files of source files.

description.zh: 待删除的播放流文件URL，多个URL用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The URL of the media stream file that you want to delete. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,).
The ID of the media asset.

descriptions.en: Delete multiple media streams at a time.
